name: Pizza
style: low-poly, flat colours; a whole pepperoni pizza, a faceted disc with a raised crust rim and about 30 pepperoni slices; normalised by its diameter (0.30 m), which makes it 0.0143 m tall

source.author: Quaternius
source.note: Wave-1 row 193 named a Quaternius static model on poly.pizza (Cloudflare challenge, off limits); the same artist's Ultimate Food Pack (Oct 2019) is on OpenGameArt as 'Low Poly Food Pack', CC0, the same pinned zip as sushi-nigiri. The pack has `Pizza` (whole), `Pizza_Burned` (whole, charred) and `Pizza_Slice`; this is the whole `Pizza`. Size: the height is tiny, so the diameter was normalised: the source is 20.95 times wider than tall, and a 0.30 m pizza makes `height` 0.0143 m (bbox 0.30 x 0.0143 x 0.30 m). Round, so yaw stays 0. Colours (noon), matching the food set: crust in sky with an iris shade at a low threshold (-0.3, so only the underside darkens), cheese in moon with a sky shade, pepperoni in accent with an iris shade like the salmon. The pepperoni are drawn without their own ink hull (thin discs whose hulls showed as dark crescents above each slice); the red on cream reads on its own. Static, no clips.
